items.author: Prasann Prem, Nov 4
items.summary: The hidden cost of moving reporting from Tableau to code. His team is moving some dashboards to React, and building is faster, but a two-hour Tableau change becomes a two-week release cycle. Keep fast-changing dashboards in a BI tool and put metrics in a semantic layer. 52 reactions, 18 comments.

items.author: Shane Russell, Nov 3
items.summary: A Director of FP&A who hasn't built a Power BI dashboard in months: he describes the dashboard in plain English and AI writes the warehouse query and charts. Definitions still matter, and review everything before it goes to leadership. 22 reactions, 3 comments.

items.author: Faizaan Fareed, Nov 3
items.summary: A 3D warehouse-occupancy map inside Power BI, built as a custom Three.js visual in a PBIP, with 14,000 locations colored by fill rate and separate director and floor-supervisor views. 98 reactions, 12 comments, 7 reposts.

items.author: Sally Xu, Nov 3
items.summary: She built "Data Bot", a Grok Bot teammate that digs into metric changes, analyzes experiments and visualizes data, so the data team gets fewer one-off requests. 117 reactions, 9 comments, 2 reposts.

items.author: Otso Karvinen, Nov 4
items.summary: His agentic AI agency is building its own dashboard tool because agents can't create or edit Looker Studio dashboards through an API. 77 reactions, 40 comments.
